> **Caveat:** June is a retroactive capture (mostly items dated 06-26, with a
> 44-item January 2026 BCC backfill). July is a near-single-snapshot capture
> (07-04, one daily cycle). Cross-month comparisons therefore reflect
> *capture availability* as much as real-world activity. Structural
> comparisons are made carefully; volume comparisons are artifact.

## 1. SilverLeaf Emergence: June → July

The defining cross-month narrative is the **start of SilverLeaf discovery
coverage**:

| Metric | June 2026 | July 2026 |
|--------|-----------|-----------|
| `silverleaf_discovery` items | 0 | 11 |
| SilverLeaf entity matches | 0 | ENT-COMM-SILVERLEAF (10) + ENT-EDU-SILVERLEAF-K8, ENT-REC-BEACH-VALLEY-MINI-GOLF, ENT-RETAIL-SILVERLEAF-COMMONS |
| SilverLeaf filter matches | 0 | 11 `silverleaf_northwest_dev`, 10 `neighborhood_silverleaf` |

The `silverleaf_discovery` profile went live 2026-07-04 (via St. Johns Citizen
search). All 11 items are `pending_review` / `unverified`.

**Continuity into the public product:** SilverLeaf is the first
neighborhood-specific product direction (`docs/homeowner_perspective/`); July
is the first month the intel stream actually covers it. This is the strongest
June→July structural change.

## 2. NBOR Snapshot Volume Stability

| Metric | June 2026 | July 2026 |
|--------|-----------|-----------|
| NBOR items | 25 (single snapshot, dated 06-26) | 25 (single snapshot, dated 07-04) |
| Beat split | utilities, rezoning, site plans | utilities (8), rezoning (7), site plans (10), roadwork (1) |

The two months capture near-identical NBOR snapshot volumes — but the June
snapshot (06-26) and July snapshot (07-04) are only **8 days apart**, so this
is the same cadence window, not two months of independent activity.

**Key continuity:** The June 8 and June 26 NBOR files are byte-identical
duplicates (same 25 IDs `SJC-NBOR-20260626-*`); June counts once. This is
recorded as a data-quality correction (see COVERAGE.md).

## 5. Review-Status Divergence (Capture Health)

| Metric | June | July |
|--------|------|------|
| Total | 99 | 38 |
| Verified | 83 | 0 |
| Pending review | 10 | 38 |
| Archived | 5 | 0 |

June went through review; July has not. All 38 July items are
`pending_review`, and 11 of them are unverified SilverLeaf candidates (3
high-sensitivity crime items needing human review). The **review backfill for
July is the immediate forward action**, and the SilverLeaf incident candidates
are the top risk in the queue.

## 6. CDD / BCC: One-Time Extractions Not Sustained

- **CDD (9 items in June):** captured once (06-26). Trout Creek's Jul 7 / Jul
  23 meetings were pre-announced but no outcomes captured. Zero July CDD items.
- **BCC (44 items in June):** a January 2026 retroactive agenda extraction.
  Zero actual June or July BCC meeting coverage (GAP-001, broken Clerk links).

Both are evidence that **snapshot backfills produce a spike in one month but
do not become recurring coverage** without a live weekly monitor.

## 8. Recommendations

1. **Human review of the 11 SilverLeaf candidates** — top priority. Verify
   the 3 high-sensitivity crime items (ICE detainer, construction-site
   shooting, airlifted minor) against official records before anything.
2. **July review backfill:** all 38 July items are `pending_review`; run the
   review cycle (as done for June's 99) so July can be promoted/archived.
3. **Fix the NBOR duplicate capture** (June 8/June 26 identical files) so
   future snapshots don't double-count — see COVERAGE.md correction.
4. **Close GAP-001 (BCC) and GAP-003 (school)** — two consecutive months with
   zero BCC decision and zero school coverage.
5. **Prioritize daily catch-up (~29 days overdue)** so July-style gaps
   (emergency mgmt, county news, sheriff) don't recur.
6. **SilverLeaf product direction is now data-backed** — 11 items + 5 entity
   matches justify continuing the `silverleaf_discovery` profile into August.
